characters.name: Dick Gumshoe
characters.description1: Homicide detective at the local precinct. In charge of the initial investigation.

characters.name: Ernest Amano
characters.description1: Benefactor when I studied in Germany. Director of the Amano Group.

characters.name: Lance Amano
characters.description1: Son of Ernest Amano. Victim of the kidnapping. I knew him when he was a child.
characters.description2: Kidnapping victim. Escaped from  the kidnappers' hideout and was found at the stadium.

characters.name: Kay Faraday
characters.description1: Self-purported Great Thief. She suddenly appeared, but why was she stalking me?
characters.description2: Self-purported Great Thief. She claims to be the Yatagarasu, but...

characters.name: Shi-Long Lang
characters.description1: An Interpol Agent. He is in charge of this kidnapping case for some odd reason.
characters.description2: Boasts he has the highest arrest rate in Interpol. In charge of kidnapping case.

characters.name: Shih-na
characters.description1: Lang's trusty secretary. Level-headed, she supports him in his investigations.

characters.name: Oliver Deacon
characters.description1: Amano family butler, and Lance's private tutor. Could not be contacted recently.
characters.description2: Amano family butler, and Lance's private tutor. Was found dead.
characters.description3: A felon named Colin Devorae. Became Amano family butler after escape. Found dead.
characters.description4: Murder victim. A felon. Was separated from his daughter, Lauren Paups.

characters.name: Mike Meekins
characters.description1: Precinct police officer. Was conducting investigation while in Blue Badger costume.

characters.name: Lauren Paups
characters.description1: Lance Amano's girlfriend. Came to Gatewater Land in search of Lance.
characters.description2: Lance Amano's girlfriend. Conspired with Deacon to kidnap Lance.
characters.description3: Lance Amano's girlfriend. 1 of the kidnappers. Separated from her real father, Deacon.

characters.name: Ema Skye
characters.description1: High schooler in Europe to become forensic scientist. On school break.

characters.name: Security Lady
characters.description1: The lady inside the Pink Badger. I believe her real name is Wendy Oldbag.

evidences.name: Prosecutor's Badge
evidences.description1: Proof of my profession. However, I prefer to keep it in my pocket.

evidences.name: Gatewater Land Pamphlet
evidences.description1: Map and explanation of park attractions listed.

evidences.name: Bad Badger's Head
evidences.description1: Costumes separate into head and body. This head was left in the Isolation Room.

evidences.name: Blue Badger Bible
evidences.description1: Book detailing info on the whole Badger family.

evidences.name: Badger Photo Rally
evidences.description1: There's only 1 of each Badger in the park. Try to get the whole Badger family!

evidences.name: Stolen Costumes
evidences.description1: The kidnappers stole three costumes: a Blue, a Proto and a Bad Badger.
evidences.description2: Blue Badger = Lauren Paups Proto Badger = Lance Amano Bad Badger = Oliver Deacon

evidences.name: Preliminary Findings → Mr. Deacon's Murder Notes
evidences.description1: Victim: Oliver Deacon. Seems he was shot dead.
evidences.description2: Victim, Deacon, shot from ABD through shoulder.
evidences.description3: Body was moved. Shot from ABD through shoulder.

evidences.name: Mr. Deacon's Pendant
evidences.description1: It's shaped like a horse. "Colin Devorae" is engraved on the back.

evidences.name: Blue Badgermobile
evidences.description1: Mobile shop on three wheels. Was parked inside Wild, Wild West area garage.

evidences.name: Victim's Costume
evidences.description1: He was likely wearing one due to the footprints' shape and the lack of blood.
evidences.description2: Worn at the time of the shooting. Gunpowder burn is proof he was shot from point blank.

evidences.name: Love Letter
evidences.description1: Letter for Lance Amano. The sender is the "Tender Lender Loan Company".

evidences.name: Colin Devorae Dossier
evidences.description1:
Details Oliver Deacon's real name and history. [info]Caolin Devorae
Sex: Male
Dominant Hand: Right
Height: 5'8"
Weight: 123.45 lbs

Whereabouts unknown after his escape from Penn E. Dent Prison. Stole a gun from a guard during his scape. We thought he might head for where his wife and sole daughter are, but despite our surveillance, he has yet to show up.

evidences.name: Broken Prop Sword
evidences.description1: Was used to jam the handle to the hideout's door from the inside.
evidences.description2: Culprit hit me in the right temple area with this.

evidences.name: Missing Model Gun
evidences.description1: Was ripped from the Bad Badger costume. It's capable of firing blanks.

evidences.name: Ms. Paups's Pendant
evidences.description1: It's shaped like a pair of wings. "Lauren D." is engraved on the back.

evidences.name: Revolver
evidences.description1: Used to kill Deacon. Was originally stolen from guard by victim during escape.

evidences.name: Mirror Fragments
evidences.description1: These were found inside the victim's costume. Why were they there in the first place?
evidences.description2: Different from the mirrors on the walls. Very thick and has a design on the back.

testimonies.testimony: They had me shut in that room, blindfolded, the entire time.
But the kidnappers suddenly disappeared around the time I heard rain falling outside.
My hands were cuffed, but it was a stroke of luck that they left me alone.
I made my escape and ran away from that room as fast as I could.
The door leading outside was locked tight, so I had to use the underground passageway.

source.evidence_span: Was used to jam the handle to the hideout's door from the inside.
source.testimony_span: you didn't notice the bloody letters
source.context_span: Lance: They must've used some drug to knock me out. Because before I knew it, I was off in La-La Land again. When I woke up, I was in the kidnappers' hideout already, all tied up.

turns.summarizedContext: The witness Lance claims he was kidnapped and held in the kidnappers' hideout.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims the hideout door was locked while he was inside the hideout.
Fact 2: The evidence suggests a prop sword was used to jam the handle to the hideout's door from the inside.
Prop 1: If a person is inside a room where the door handle is jammed by an item, the person could remove the item and thus not thinks the door is locked.
